source.reimbursement:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../flow.schema.json
# Staff reimbursement, the first consumer's first workflow, drafted on 2026-09-30 by an agent that had read only
# flow-format.md and the sections it cites, as authoring-flows.md §6 prescribes; kept as that agent wrote it, and
# judged by the defects it found (reimbursement-cold-draft.md), except where ADR-0145 answered what it asked: who
# confirmed a line's nature is recorded, and must be a person, and the day of an expense is a date.
#
# Assumptions the business has not decided:
# - A claim is recorded in Xero as a bill, and the bill is paid separately, so "paid" is a step of its own after
#   the Xero record is read back.
# - Which function reviews, records and pays is undecided. The flow names no person and no fixed function:
#   approval is recorded against a BusinessFunction the approver names, and who may take each step is the
#   application's (ADR-0114).
# - Amounts are in one home currency, assumed USD here; a line spent in another currency is entered at the amount
#   charged in the home currency.
module: reimbursement

# a version of this flow is approved by a person, never an agent (ADR-0187)
publishing: { taken_by: [human] }
categories: [to_do, in_progress, in_service, closed]

enumerations:
  SpendNature: [EXPENSE, PURCHASE]
  ReturnReason: [MISSING_RECEIPT, WRONG_AMOUNT, WRONG_CATEGORY, NEEDS_DETAIL, OTHER]
  RejectionReason: [NOT_BUSINESS_SPEND, DUPLICATE, SHOULD_BE_PROCUREMENT, OTHER]
  CorrectionReason: [TYPING_ERROR, WRONG_BILL]

sequences:
  claim_number:
    description: Numbers the company's reimbursement claims.

evaluators:
  xero:
    description: Xero, the company's accounting system, which owns the bills claims are recorded as and their payment.
    functions:
      bill_matches:
        description: Whether Xero holds a bill with this id that carries this claim number as its reference and totals this amount.
        arguments:
          bill_id: { type: string }
          claim_number: { type: string }
          amount: { type: money(USD) }
        fresh: 10 min
      bill_paid:
        description: Whether the bill with this id is paid in full in Xero.
        arguments:
          bill_id: { type: string }
        fresh: 10 min

types:
  Employee:
    description: A person employed by the company, who may claim expenses and act on claims.
    tracking: record
    taken_by: [human, service]
    attributes:
      user_id: { type: identity, actor_kind: human, unique: true }
      name: { type: string, optional: true, personal: true }
      xero_contact_id:
        type: string
        external: xero
        optional: true
        description: The Xero contact the employee's bills are raised against.
    states:
      ACTIVE:
        category: in_service
        description: Employed, and may claim and act on claims.
      LEFT:
        category: closed
        final: true
        description: No longer employed.
    transitions:
      onboard:
        kind: initial
        to: ACTIVE
        required_inputs: [user_id]
        optional_inputs: [name]
      link_xero_contact:
        kind: internal
        from: ACTIVE
        description: Records the Xero contact the employee's bills are raised against.
        required_inputs: [xero_contact_id]
      leave:
        kind: external
        from: ACTIVE
        to: LEFT
      forget:
        kind: erasure
        taken_by: [human]
        description: Erases this store's copy of the employee's name.
        inputs:
          reason: { type: string }

  AssistantAgent:
    description: An AI agent that makes requests of its own, such as suggesting whether a claim line is an expense or a purchase; it never commits a financial write.
    tracking: record
    taken_by: [human]
    attributes:
      agent_id: { type: identity, actor_kind: agent, unique: true }
      name: { type: string }
    states:
      ENABLED: { category: in_service }
      RETIRED: { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      register:
        kind: initial
        to: ENABLED
        required_inputs: [agent_id, name]
      retire:
        kind: external
        from: ENABLED
        to: RETIRED

  BusinessFunction:
    description: A function of the company, a role or team such as finance or management, under whose authority claims are approved; never a named person.
    tracking: record
    taken_by: [human, service]
    attributes:
      name: { type: string, unique: true }
    states:
      ACTIVE: { category: in_service }
      DISSOLVED: { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      establish:
        kind: initial
        to: ACTIVE
        required_inputs: [name]
      dissolve:
        kind: external
        from: ACTIVE
        to: DISSOLVED

  ExpenseCategory:
    description: A category of spending a claim line is filed under, such as travel, meals, equipment or other, with the policy amount above which a line is flagged.
    tracking: record
    taken_by: [human]
    attributes:
      name: { type: string, unique: true }
      policy_amount:
        type: money(USD)
        description: The most a single line of this category claims within policy; a line above it is allowed, and flagged.
    states:
      IN_USE: { category: in_service }
      RETIRED: { category: closed, final: true }
    conditions:
      policy_amount_positive:
        description: The policy amount given is above zero.
        expression: inputs.policy_amount > USD 0.00
        remedy: self_serviceable
    transitions:
      define:
        kind: initial
        to: IN_USE
        required_inputs: [name, policy_amount]
        guards:
          policy_amount_positive: deny
      change_policy_amount:
        kind: internal
        from: IN_USE
        required_inputs: [policy_amount]
        guards:
          policy_amount_positive: deny
      retire:
        kind: external
        from: IN_USE
        to: RETIRED

  Claim:
    description: A staff reimbursement claim, one employee's request to be paid back for business spending, made of line items; it is recorded in Xero as a bill and paid separately.
    tracking: record
    # people and services take a claim's transitions, never the agent, which commits no financial write
    taken_by: [human, service]
    attributes:
      number:
        type: string
        identifier: { sequence: claim_number, format: "EXP-{n:5}" }
        unique: true
      claimant:
        reference: Employee
        description: The employee who spent the money and is paid back.
      title:
        type: string
        optional: true
        personal: true
        description: What the claim is for, in the claimant's words; free text may name someone, so it is personal, and optional only so that erasure can remove it.
      lines:
        reference: "ClaimLine[]"
        aggregation: composite
        opposite: claim
        cascade:
          - { on: [pay, reject, withdraw], transition: close, limit: 200 }
      first_submitted_at: { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      submitted_at: { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      return_reason: { type: ReturnReason, optional: true }
      approving_function:
        reference: BusinessFunction
        optional: true
        description: The function under whose authority the claim was approved.
      approved_at: { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      xero_bill_id:
        type: string
        external: xero
        optional: true
        description: The id of the bill the claim is recorded as in Xero.
      recorded_at: { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      verified_at: { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      paid_at: { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      rejection_reason: { type: RejectionReason, optional: true }
    states:
      DRAFT:
        category: to_do
        description: Being written by the claimant, and seen by no one else.
      SUBMITTED:
        category: in_progress
        description: Submitted, and under review, when a person confirms each line's nature.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, submitted_at]
      RETURNED:
        category: to_do
        description: Sent back to the claimant for changes.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, return_reason]
      REVIEWED:
        category: in_progress
        description: Reviewed, with every line's nature confirmed, and waiting for approval by a function.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, submitted_at]
      APPROVED:
        category: in_progress
        description: Approved by a function, and waiting for a person to record it in Xero.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, submitted_at, approving_function, approved_at]
      RECORDED:
        category: in_progress
        description: Recorded in Xero as a bill by a person, and waiting for the record to be read back.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, submitted_at, approving_function, approved_at, xero_bill_id, recorded_at]
      VERIFIED:
        category: in_progress
        description: Its Xero bill read back and found to match, and waiting for payment.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, submitted_at, approving_function, approved_at, xero_bill_id, recorded_at, verified_at]
      PAID:
        category: closed
        final: true
        description: Paid to the claimant.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, submitted_at, approving_function, approved_at, xero_bill_id, recorded_at, verified_at, paid_at]
      REJECTED:
        category: closed
        final: true
        description: Refused, and will not be paid.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, rejection_reason]
      WITHDRAWN:
        category: closed
        final: true
        description: Withdrawn by the claimant before approval.
    derived_attributes:
      total:
        description: The sum of the amounts of the claim's lines, those removed from it left out.
        expression: "sum(l in lines where l.state != ClaimLine.REMOVED: l.amount)"
      over_policy_lines:
        description: The number of the claim's lines above their category's policy amount, shown to everyone acting on the claim.
        expression: count(l in lines where l.state != ClaimLine.REMOVED and l.over_policy)
    summary: [number, state, claimant, total, over_policy_lines]
    invariants:
      lines_within_reach: { description: A claim holds at most the 200 lines its cascade and its erasure take, expression: "count(l in lines) <= 200" }
      has_title:
        description: Every claim has a title, until erasure removes it.
        expression: title is not null
    conditions:
      has_lines:
        description: The claim has at least one line not removed.
        expression: count(l in lines where l.state != ClaimLine.REMOVED) > 0
        remedy: unreachable_from_here
      lines_classified:
        description: Every line of the claim not removed has its nature, expense or purchase, confirmed by a person.
        expression: "all(l in lines where l.state != ClaimLine.REMOVED: l.nature is not null)"
        remedy: dependent
      lines_within_policy:
        description: No line of the claim is above its category's policy amount.
        expression: over_policy_lines == 0
        remedy: unreachable_from_here
      function_active:
        description: The function named as approving the claim is active.
        expression: inputs.approving_function.state == BusinessFunction.ACTIVE
        remedy: self_serviceable
      bill_matches_xero:
        description: Xero holds a bill with the recorded id that carries the claim's number and totals the claim.
        expression: xero.bill_matches(xero_bill_id, number, total)
        remedy: delegable
      bill_paid_in_xero:
        description: Xero shows the claim's bill paid in full.
        expression: xero.bill_paid(xero_bill_id)
        remedy: delegable
      payment_not_in_future:
        description: The payment date given is not in the future.
        expression: inputs.paid_at <= now
        remedy: self_serviceable
    transitions:
      draft:
        kind: initial
        to: DRAFT
        description: The claimant starts a claim.
        required_inputs: [claimant, title]
      add_line:
        kind: internal
        from: [DRAFT, RETURNED]
        description: Adds a line item to the claim.
        inputs:
          amount: { type: money(USD) }
          category: { reference: ExpenseCategory }
          expense_date: { type: date }
          receipt: { type: file }
          purpose: { type: string, optional: true, personal: true }
          merchant: { type: string, optional: true }
          original_amount: { type: "decimal(12,2)", optional: true }
          original_currency: { type: string, optional: true }
        effect:
          - create:
              type: ClaimLine
              transition: add
              inputs:
                claim: this
                amount: inputs.amount
                category: inputs.category
                expense_date: inputs.expense_date
                receipt: inputs.receipt
                purpose: inputs.purpose
                merchant: inputs.merchant
                original_amount: inputs.original_amount
                original_currency: inputs.original_currency
      submit:
        kind: external
        from: DRAFT
        to: SUBMITTED
        description: The claimant submits the claim for review.
        guards:
          has_lines: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: first_submitted_at, expr: now }
          - assign: { location: submitted_at, expr: now }
      resubmit:
        kind: external
        from: RETURNED
        to: SUBMITTED
        description: The claimant submits the claim again after changing it.
        guards:
          has_lines: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: submitted_at, expr: now }
      return_for_changes:
        kind: external
        from: [SUBMITTED, REVIEWED]
        to: RETURNED
        description: A reviewer or approver sends the claim back to the claimant for changes.
        required_inputs: [return_reason]
        inputs:
          note:
            type: string
            personal: true
            description: What the claimant should change.
      complete_review:
        kind: external
        taken_by: [human]
        from: SUBMITTED
        to: REVIEWED
        description: The reviewer finishes the review, every line's nature confirmed.
        guards:
          lines_classified: deny
      approve:
        kind: external
        taken_by: [human]
        from: REVIEWED
        to: APPROVED
        description: A person approves the claim under the authority of a function.
        required_inputs: [approving_function]
        guards:
          function_active: deny
          lines_within_policy: warn
        effect:
          - assign: { location: approved_at, expr: now }
      reject:
        kind: external
        taken_by: [human]
        from: [SUBMITTED, REVIEWED]
        to: REJECTED
        description: A reviewer or approver refuses the claim.
        required_inputs: [rejection_reason]
        inputs:
          note:
            type: string
            optional: true
            personal: true
            description: Why the claim was refused, in words.
      withdraw:
        kind: external
        from: [DRAFT, SUBMITTED, RETURNED, REVIEWED]
        to: WITHDRAWN
        description: The claimant withdraws the claim before it is approved.
      record_in_xero:
        kind: external
        from: APPROVED
        to: RECORDED
        description: A person records the claim in Xero as a bill and gives the bill's id.
        required_inputs: [xero_bill_id]
        effect:
          - assign: { location: recorded_at, expr: now }
      correct_xero_bill_id:
        kind: internal
        from: RECORDED
        description: Corrects the Xero bill id recorded, when the read-back shows it was wrong.
        corrects: [xero_bill_id]
        required_inputs: [xero_bill_id]
        inputs:
          reason: { type: CorrectionReason }
      verify_xero_record:
        kind: external
        from: RECORDED
        to: VERIFIED
        description: Reads the Xero bill back and confirms it matches the claim.
        guards:
          bill_matches_xero: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: verified_at, expr: now }
      pay:
        kind: external
        taken_by: [human, service]
        from: VERIFIED
        to: PAID
        description: Records that the bill was paid to the claimant, as Xero shows.
        required_inputs: [paid_at]
        guards:
          payment_not_in_future: deny
          bill_paid_in_xero: deny
      erase_personal_data:
        kind: erasure
        taken_by: [human]
        description: Erases the claim's personal data and that of its lines.
        inputs:
          reason: { type: string }
        effect:
          - foreach:
              item: l
              array: lines
              limit: 200
              steps:
                - call: { target: l, transition: erase, inputs: { reason: inputs.reason } }
    metrics:
      submission_to_payment:
        description: The median time from a claim's first submission to its payment, by the month it was paid.
        source: objects
        item: c
        filter: c.paid_at is not null
        dimensions:
          paid_month: month(c.paid_at)
        time_dimension: c.paid_at
        expression: median(c.paid_at - c.first_submitted_at)
        flag_when: { slow: "value > 14 days" }
      claimant_amount_claimed:
        description: The amount each claimant claimed, by the month of first submission, over claims submitted and not withdrawn; it names a person.
        source: objects
        item: c
        filter: c.first_submitted_at is not null and c.state != Claim.WITHDRAWN
        dimensions:
          claimant: c.claimant
          submitted_month: month(c.first_submitted_at)
        time_dimension: c.first_submitted_at
        expression: sum(c.total)
      claimant_over_policy_lines:
        description: The number of lines above policy on each claimant's claims, by the month of first submission, over claims submitted and not withdrawn; it names a person.
        source: objects
        item: c
        filter: c.first_submitted_at is not null and c.state != Claim.WITHDRAWN
        dimensions:
          claimant: c.claimant
          submitted_month: month(c.first_submitted_at)
        time_dimension: c.first_submitted_at
        expression: sum(c.over_policy_lines)
      approval_policy_flags:
        description: How many times a claim was approved with a line above its category's policy amount, by rule and month.
        source: attempt_counts
        item: a
        filter: a.flagged
        dimensions:
          rule: a.clause
          flagged_month: month(a.day)
        time_dimension: a.day
        expression: sum(a.count)

  ClaimLine:
    description: One item of a claim, a single amount spent on one date in one category, with its receipt.
    tracking: record
    # the agent only suggests a line's nature (`suggest`, its own); everything else is a person's or a service's
    taken_by: [human, service]
    attributes:
      claim: { reference: Claim, opposite: lines }
      amount: { type: money(USD) }
      original_amount:
        type: decimal(12,2)
        optional: true
        description: The amount spent, in the currency it was spent in, where that is not the home currency; recorded, and never computed with (ADR-0145).
      original_currency:
        type: string
        optional: true
        description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency the amount was spent in, beside original_amount.
      category: { reference: ExpenseCategory }
      expense_date:
        type: date
        description: The day the money was spent, a calendar day with no time and no zone (ADR-0145).
      receipt: { type: file }
      purpose:
        type: string
        optional: true
        personal: true
        description: What the money was spent on, in the claimant's words.
      merchant: { type: string, optional: true }
      suggested_nature:
        type: SpendNature
        optional: true
        description: The agent's suggestion of whether the line is an expense or a purchase, which commits nothing.
      suggestion_rationale:
        type: string
        optional: true
        personal: true
        description: The agent's reasons for its suggestion, shown to the person who confirms it.
      nature:
        type: SpendNature
        optional: true
        description: Whether the line is an expense or a purchase, as a person confirmed it.
      nature_confirmed_by:
        type: actor_kind
        optional: true
        description: The kind of actor that confirmed the line's nature, recorded as it was confirmed (ADR-0145).
    states:
      LISTED:
        category: in_progress
        description: On its claim.
      REMOVED:
        category: closed
        final: true
        description: Taken off its claim by the claimant before approval.
      CLOSED:
        category: closed
        final: true
        description: Its claim was paid, rejected or withdrawn.
    derived_attributes:
      over_policy:
        description: The line's amount is above its category's policy amount.
        expression: amount > category.policy_amount
    invariants:
      spent_amount_has_its_currency:
        description: An amount spent in another currency names that currency.
        expression: original_amount is null or original_currency is not null
      confirmed_by_a_person:
        description: A line's nature is confirmed by a person, never by the agent, which only suggests it, so the agent never commits a financial write.
        expression: nature is null or (nature_confirmed_by is not null and nature_confirmed_by == human)
    conditions:
      amount_positive:
        description: The amount given is above zero.
        expression: inputs.amount > USD 0.00
        remedy: self_serviceable
      spent_in_past:
        description: The day of the expense is not in the future, allowing a day, since the claimant's today is a day ahead of UTC's east of it for part of each day.
        expression: inputs.expense_date <= date(now) + 1 day
        remedy: self_serviceable
      category_in_use:
        description: The category given is in use.
        expression: inputs.category.state == ExpenseCategory.IN_USE
        remedy: self_serviceable
      within_policy:
        description: The amount given is no more than its category's policy amount.
        expression: inputs.amount <= inputs.category.policy_amount
        remedy: self_serviceable
      claim_editable:
        description: The line's claim is a draft or has been sent back for changes.
        expression: claim.state == Claim.DRAFT or claim.state == Claim.RETURNED
        remedy: dependent
      claim_under_review:
        description: The line's claim is under review.
        expression: claim.state == Claim.SUBMITTED
        remedy: dependent
      nature_unconfirmed:
        description: No person has yet confirmed the line's nature.
        expression: nature is null
        remedy: unreachable_from_here
    transitions:
      add:
        kind: initial
        to: LISTED
        description: A line is added to its claim.
        only_via: [Claim.add_line]
        required_inputs: [claim, amount, category, expense_date, receipt]
        optional_inputs: [purpose, merchant, original_amount, original_currency]
        guards:
          amount_positive: deny
          spent_in_past: deny
          category_in_use: deny
          within_policy: warn
      amend:
        kind: internal
        from: LISTED
        description: The claimant replaces the line's details, which undoes any suggestion or confirmation of its nature.
        required_inputs: [amount, category, expense_date, receipt]
        optional_inputs: [purpose, merchant, original_amount, original_currency]
        guards:
          claim_editable: deny
          amount_positive: deny
          spent_in_past: deny
          category_in_use: deny
          within_policy: warn
        effect:
          - clear: [suggested_nature, suggestion_rationale, nature, nature_confirmed_by]
      discard:
        kind: external
        from: LISTED
        to: REMOVED
        description: The claimant takes the line off the claim.
        guards:
          claim_editable: deny
      suggest_nature:
        kind: internal
        from: LISTED
        description: The agent suggests whether the line is an expense or a purchase; the suggestion commits nothing.
        # the agent's, so its generated tools offer it (ADR-0189)
        taken_by: [agent]
        required_inputs: [suggested_nature]
        optional_inputs: [suggestion_rationale]
        guards:
          nature_unconfirmed: deny
      confirm_nature:
        kind: internal
        from: LISTED
        description: A person confirms the line's nature, accepting or overriding the agent's suggestion.
        required_inputs: [nature]
        guards:
          claim_under_review: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: nature_confirmed_by, expr: actor.kind }
      close:
        kind: external
        from: LISTED
        to: CLOSED
        description: The line closes with its claim.
        only_via: [Claim.pay, Claim.reject, Claim.withdraw]
      erase:
        kind: erasure
        taken_by: [human]
        description: Erases the line's personal data.
        inputs:
          reason: { type: string }
    metrics:
      amount_claimed_by_category:
        description: The amount claimed in each category, by the month the money was spent, over the lines of every claim submitted and not withdrawn.
        source: objects
        item: l
        filter: l.state != ClaimLine.REMOVED and l.claim.first_submitted_at is not null and l.claim.state != Claim.WITHDRAWN
        dimensions:
          expense_category: l.category
          spent_month: month(l.expense_date)
        time_dimension: l.expense_date
        expression: sum(l.amount)
      line_policy_flags:
        description: How many times a line was entered or amended above its category's policy amount, by rule and month.
        source: attempt_counts
        item: a
        filter: a.flagged
        dimensions:
          rule: a.clause
          flagged_month: month(a.day)
        time_dimension: a.day
        expression: sum(a.count)

{"reimbursement":"# yaml-language-server: $schema=../flow.schema.json
# Staff reimbursement, the first consumer's first workflow, drafted on 2026-09-30 by an agent that had read only
# flow-format.md and the sections it cites, as authoring-flows.md §6 prescribes; kept as that agent wrote it, and
# judged by the defects it found (reimbursement-cold-draft.md), except where ADR-0145 answered what it asked: who
# confirmed a line's nature is recorded, and must be a person, and the day of an expense is a date.
#
# Assumptions the business has not decided:
# - A claim is recorded in Xero as a bill, and the bill is paid separately, so "paid" is a step of its own after
#   the Xero record is read back.
# - Which function reviews, records and pays is undecided. The flow names no person and no fixed function:
#   approval is recorded against a BusinessFunction the approver names, and who may take each step is the
#   application's (ADR-0114).
# - Amounts are in one home currency, assumed USD here; a line spent in another currency is entered at the amount
#   charged in the home currency.
module: reimbursement

# a version of this flow is approved by a person, never an agent (ADR-0187)
publishing: { taken_by: [human] }
categories: [to_do, in_progress, in_service, closed]

enumerations:
  SpendNature: [EXPENSE, PURCHASE]
  ReturnReason: [MISSING_RECEIPT, WRONG_AMOUNT, WRONG_CATEGORY, NEEDS_DETAIL, OTHER]
  RejectionReason: [NOT_BUSINESS_SPEND, DUPLICATE, SHOULD_BE_PROCUREMENT, OTHER]
  CorrectionReason: [TYPING_ERROR, WRONG_BILL]

sequences:
  claim_number:
    description: Numbers the company's reimbursement claims.

evaluators:
  xero:
    description: Xero, the company's accounting system, which owns the bills claims are recorded as and their payment.
    functions:
      bill_matches:
        description: Whether Xero holds a bill with this id that carries this claim number as its reference and totals this amount.
        arguments:
          bill_id: { type: string }
          claim_number: { type: string }
          amount: { type: money(USD) }
        fresh: 10 min
      bill_paid:
        description: Whether the bill with this id is paid in full in Xero.
        arguments:
          bill_id: { type: string }
        fresh: 10 min

types:
  Employee:
    description: A person employed by the company, who may claim expenses and act on claims.
    tracking: record
    taken_by: [human, service]
    attributes:
      user_id: { type: identity, actor_kind: human, unique: true }
      name: { type: string, optional: true, personal: true }
      xero_contact_id:
        type: string
        external: xero
        optional: true
        description: The Xero contact the employee's bills are raised against.
    states:
      ACTIVE:
        category: in_service
        description: Employed, and may claim and act on claims.
      LEFT:
        category: closed
        final: true
        description: No longer employed.
    transitions:
      onboard:
        kind: initial
        to: ACTIVE
        required_inputs: [user_id]
        optional_inputs: [name]
      link_xero_contact:
        kind: internal
        from: ACTIVE
        description: Records the Xero contact the employee's bills are raised against.
        required_inputs: [xero_contact_id]
      leave:
        kind: external
        from: ACTIVE
        to: LEFT
      forget:
        kind: erasure
        taken_by: [human]
        description: Erases this store's copy of the employee's name.
        inputs:
          reason: { type: string }

  AssistantAgent:
    description: An AI agent that makes requests of its own, such as suggesting whether a claim line is an expense or a purchase; it never commits a financial write.
    tracking: record
    taken_by: [human]
    attributes:
      agent_id: { type: identity, actor_kind: agent, unique: true }
      name: { type: string }
    states:
      ENABLED: { category: in_service }
      RETIRED: { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      register:
        kind: initial
        to: ENABLED
        required_inputs: [agent_id, name]
      retire:
        kind: external
        from: ENABLED
        to: RETIRED

  BusinessFunction:
    description: A function of the company, a role or team such as finance or management, under whose authority claims are approved; never a named person.
    tracking: record
    taken_by: [human, service]
    attributes:
      name: { type: string, unique: true }
    states:
      ACTIVE: { category: in_service }
      DISSOLVED: { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      establish:
        kind: initial
        to: ACTIVE
        required_inputs: [name]
      dissolve:
        kind: external
        from: ACTIVE
        to: DISSOLVED

  ExpenseCategory:
    description: A category of spending a claim line is filed under, such as travel, meals, equipment or other, with the policy amount above which a line is flagged.
    tracking: record
    taken_by: [human]
    attributes:
      name: { type: string, unique: true }
      policy_amount:
        type: money(USD)
        description: The most a single line of this category claims within policy; a line above it is allowed, and flagged.
    states:
      IN_USE: { category: in_service }
      RETIRED: { category: closed, final: true }
    conditions:
      policy_amount_positive:
        description: The policy amount given is above zero.
        expression: inputs.policy_amount > USD 0.00
        remedy: self_serviceable
    transitions:
      define:
        kind: initial
        to: IN_USE
        required_inputs: [name, policy_amount]
        guards:
          policy_amount_positive: deny
      change_policy_amount:
        kind: internal
        from: IN_USE
        required_inputs: [policy_amount]
        guards:
          policy_amount_positive: deny
      retire:
        kind: external
        from: IN_USE
        to: RETIRED

  Claim:
    description: A staff reimbursement claim, one employee's request to be paid back for business spending, made of line items; it is recorded in Xero as a bill and paid separately.
    tracking: record
    # people and services take a claim's transitions, never the agent, which commits no financial write
    taken_by: [human, service]
    attributes:
      number:
        type: string
        identifier: { sequence: claim_number, format: "EXP-{n:5}" }
        unique: true
      claimant:
        reference: Employee
        description: The employee who spent the money and is paid back.
      title:
        type: string
        optional: true
        personal: true
        description: What the claim is for, in the claimant's words; free text may name someone, so it is personal, and optional only so that erasure can remove it.
      lines:
        reference: "ClaimLine[]"
        aggregation: composite
        opposite: claim
        cascade:
          - { on: [pay, reject, withdraw], transition: close, limit: 200 }
      first_submitted_at: { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      submitted_at: { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      return_reason: { type: ReturnReason, optional: true }
      approving_function:
        reference: BusinessFunction
        optional: true
        description: The function under whose authority the claim was approved.
      approved_at: { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      xero_bill_id:
        type: string
        external: xero
        optional: true
        description: The id of the bill the claim is recorded as in Xero.
      recorded_at: { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      verified_at: { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      paid_at: { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      rejection_reason: { type: RejectionReason, optional: true }
    states:
      DRAFT:
        category: to_do
        description: Being written by the claimant, and seen by no one else.
      SUBMITTED:
        category: in_progress
        description: Submitted, and under review, when a person confirms each line's nature.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, submitted_at]
      RETURNED:
        category: to_do
        description: Sent back to the claimant for changes.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, return_reason]
      REVIEWED:
        category: in_progress
        description: Reviewed, with every line's nature confirmed, and waiting for approval by a function.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, submitted_at]
      APPROVED:
        category: in_progress
        description: Approved by a function, and waiting for a person to record it in Xero.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, submitted_at, approving_function, approved_at]
      RECORDED:
        category: in_progress
        description: Recorded in Xero as a bill by a person, and waiting for the record to be read back.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, submitted_at, approving_function, approved_at, xero_bill_id, recorded_at]
      VERIFIED:
        category: in_progress
        description: Its Xero bill read back and found to match, and waiting for payment.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, submitted_at, approving_function, approved_at, xero_bill_id, recorded_at, verified_at]
      PAID:
        category: closed
        final: true
        description: Paid to the claimant.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, submitted_at, approving_function, approved_at, xero_bill_id, recorded_at, verified_at, paid_at]
      REJECTED:
        category: closed
        final: true
        description: Refused, and will not be paid.
        required_attributes: [first_submitted_at, rejection_reason]
      WITHDRAWN:
        category: closed
        final: true
        description: Withdrawn by the claimant before approval.
    derived_attributes:
      total:
        description: The sum of the amounts of the claim's lines, those removed from it left out.
        expression: "sum(l in lines where l.state != ClaimLine.REMOVED: l.amount)"
      over_policy_lines:
        description: The number of the claim's lines above their category's policy amount, shown to everyone acting on the claim.
        expression: count(l in lines where l.state != ClaimLine.REMOVED and l.over_policy)
    summary: [number, state, claimant, total, over_policy_lines]
    invariants:
      lines_within_reach: { description: A claim holds at most the 200 lines its cascade and its erasure take, expression: "count(l in lines) <= 200" }
      has_title:
        description: Every claim has a title, until erasure removes it.
        expression: title is not null
    conditions:
      has_lines:
        description: The claim has at least one line not removed.
        expression: count(l in lines where l.state != ClaimLine.REMOVED) > 0
        remedy: unreachable_from_here
      lines_classified:
        description: Every line of the claim not removed has its nature, expense or purchase, confirmed by a person.
        expression: "all(l in lines where l.state != ClaimLine.REMOVED: l.nature is not null)"
        remedy: dependent
      lines_within_policy:
        description: No line of the claim is above its category's policy amount.
        expression: over_policy_lines == 0
        remedy: unreachable_from_here
      function_active:
        description: The function named as approving the claim is active.
        expression: inputs.approving_function.state == BusinessFunction.ACTIVE
        remedy: self_serviceable
      bill_matches_xero:
        description: Xero holds a bill with the recorded id that carries the claim's number and totals the claim.
        expression: xero.bill_matches(xero_bill_id, number, total)
        remedy: delegable
      bill_paid_in_xero:
        description: Xero shows the claim's bill paid in full.
        expression: xero.bill_paid(xero_bill_id)
        remedy: delegable
      payment_not_in_future:
        description: The payment date given is not in the future.
        expression: inputs.paid_at <= now
        remedy: self_serviceable
    transitions:
      draft:
        kind: initial
        to: DRAFT
        description: The claimant starts a claim.
        required_inputs: [claimant, title]
      add_line:
        kind: internal
        from: [DRAFT, RETURNED]
        description: Adds a line item to the claim.
        inputs:
          amount: { type: money(USD) }
          category: { reference: ExpenseCategory }
          expense_date: { type: date }
          receipt: { type: file }
          purpose: { type: string, optional: true, personal: true }
          merchant: { type: string, optional: true }
          original_amount: { type: "decimal(12,2)", optional: true }
          original_currency: { type: string, optional: true }
        effect:
          - create:
              type: ClaimLine
              transition: add
              inputs:
                claim: this
                amount: inputs.amount
                category: inputs.category
                expense_date: inputs.expense_date
                receipt: inputs.receipt
                purpose: inputs.purpose
                merchant: inputs.merchant
                original_amount: inputs.original_amount
                original_currency: inputs.original_currency
      submit:
        kind: external
        from: DRAFT
        to: SUBMITTED
        description: The claimant submits the claim for review.
        guards:
          has_lines: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: first_submitted_at, expr: now }
          - assign: { location: submitted_at, expr: now }
      resubmit:
        kind: external
        from: RETURNED
        to: SUBMITTED
        description: The claimant submits the claim again after changing it.
        guards:
          has_lines: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: submitted_at, expr: now }
      return_for_changes:
        kind: external
        from: [SUBMITTED, REVIEWED]
        to: RETURNED
        description: A reviewer or approver sends the claim back to the claimant for changes.
        required_inputs: [return_reason]
        inputs:
          note:
            type: string
            personal: true
            description: What the claimant should change.
      complete_review:
        kind: external
        taken_by: [human]
        from: SUBMITTED
        to: REVIEWED
        description: The reviewer finishes the review, every line's nature confirmed.
        guards:
          lines_classified: deny
      approve:
        kind: external
        taken_by: [human]
        from: REVIEWED
        to: APPROVED
        description: A person approves the claim under the authority of a function.
        required_inputs: [approving_function]
        guards:
          function_active: deny
          lines_within_policy: warn
        effect:
          - assign: { location: approved_at, expr: now }
      reject:
        kind: external
        taken_by: [human]
        from: [SUBMITTED, REVIEWED]
        to: REJECTED
        description: A reviewer or approver refuses the claim.
        required_inputs: [rejection_reason]
        inputs:
          note:
            type: string
            optional: true
            personal: true
            description: Why the claim was refused, in words.
      withdraw:
        kind: external
        from: [DRAFT, SUBMITTED, RETURNED, REVIEWED]
        to: WITHDRAWN
        description: The claimant withdraws the claim before it is approved.
      record_in_xero:
        kind: external
        from: APPROVED
        to: RECORDED
        description: A person records the claim in Xero as a bill and gives the bill's id.
        required_inputs: [xero_bill_id]
        effect:
          - assign: { location: recorded_at, expr: now }
      correct_xero_bill_id:
        kind: internal
        from: RECORDED
        description: Corrects the Xero bill id recorded, when the read-back shows it was wrong.
        corrects: [xero_bill_id]
        required_inputs: [xero_bill_id]
        inputs:
          reason: { type: CorrectionReason }
      verify_xero_record:
        kind: external
        from: RECORDED
        to: VERIFIED
        description: Reads the Xero bill back and confirms it matches the claim.
        guards:
          bill_matches_xero: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: verified_at, expr: now }
      pay:
        kind: external
        taken_by: [human, service]
        from: VERIFIED
        to: PAID
        description: Records that the bill was paid to the claimant, as Xero shows.
        required_inputs: [paid_at]
        guards:
          payment_not_in_future: deny
          bill_paid_in_xero: deny
      erase_personal_data:
        kind: erasure
        taken_by: [human]
        description: Erases the claim's personal data and that of its lines.
        inputs:
          reason: { type: string }
        effect:
          - foreach:
              item: l
              array: lines
              limit: 200
              steps:
                - call: { target: l, transition: erase, inputs: { reason: inputs.reason } }
    metrics:
      submission_to_payment:
        description: The median time from a claim's first submission to its payment, by the month it was paid.
        source: objects
        item: c
        filter: c.paid_at is not null
        dimensions:
          paid_month: month(c.paid_at)
        time_dimension: c.paid_at
        expression: median(c.paid_at - c.first_submitted_at)
        flag_when: { slow: "value > 14 days" }
      claimant_amount_claimed:
        description: The amount each claimant claimed, by the month of first submission, over claims submitted and not withdrawn; it names a person.
        source: objects
        item: c
        filter: c.first_submitted_at is not null and c.state != Claim.WITHDRAWN
        dimensions:
          claimant: c.claimant
          submitted_month: month(c.first_submitted_at)
        time_dimension: c.first_submitted_at
        expression: sum(c.total)
      claimant_over_policy_lines:
        description: The number of lines above policy on each claimant's claims, by the month of first submission, over claims submitted and not withdrawn; it names a person.
        source: objects
        item: c
        filter: c.first_submitted_at is not null and c.state != Claim.WITHDRAWN
        dimensions:
          claimant: c.claimant
          submitted_month: month(c.first_submitted_at)
        time_dimension: c.first_submitted_at
        expression: sum(c.over_policy_lines)
      approval_policy_flags:
        description: How many times a claim was approved with a line above its category's policy amount, by rule and month.
        source: attempt_counts
        item: a
        filter: a.flagged
        dimensions:
          rule: a.clause
          flagged_month: month(a.day)
        time_dimension: a.day
        expression: sum(a.count)

  ClaimLine:
    description: One item of a claim, a single amount spent on one date in one category, with its receipt.
    tracking: record
    # the agent only suggests a line's nature (`suggest`, its own); everything else is a person's or a service's
    taken_by: [human, service]
    attributes:
      claim: { reference: Claim, opposite: lines }
      amount: { type: money(USD) }
      original_amount:
        type: decimal(12,2)
        optional: true
        description: The amount spent, in the currency it was spent in, where that is not the home currency; recorded, and never computed with (ADR-0145).
      original_currency:
        type: string
        optional: true
        description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency the amount was spent in, beside original_amount.
      category: { reference: ExpenseCategory }
      expense_date:
        type: date
        description: The day the money was spent, a calendar day with no time and no zone (ADR-0145).
      receipt: { type: file }
      purpose:
        type: string
        optional: true
        personal: true
        description: What the money was spent on, in the claimant's words.
      merchant: { type: string, optional: true }
      suggested_nature:
        type: SpendNature
        optional: true
        description: The agent's suggestion of whether the line is an expense or a purchase, which commits nothing.
      suggestion_rationale:
        type: string
        optional: true
        personal: true
        description: The agent's reasons for its suggestion, shown to the person who confirms it.
      nature:
        type: SpendNature
        optional: true
        description: Whether the line is an expense or a purchase, as a person confirmed it.
      nature_confirmed_by:
        type: actor_kind
        optional: true
        description: The kind of actor that confirmed the line's nature, recorded as it was confirmed (ADR-0145).
    states:
      LISTED:
        category: in_progress
        description: On its claim.
      REMOVED:
        category: closed
        final: true
        description: Taken off its claim by the claimant before approval.
      CLOSED:
        category: closed
        final: true
        description: Its claim was paid, rejected or withdrawn.
    derived_attributes:
      over_policy:
        description: The line's amount is above its category's policy amount.
        expression: amount > category.policy_amount
    invariants:
      spent_amount_has_its_currency:
        description: An amount spent in another currency names that currency.
        expression: original_amount is null or original_currency is not null
      confirmed_by_a_person:
        description: A line's nature is confirmed by a person, never by the agent, which only suggests it, so the agent never commits a financial write.
        expression: nature is null or (nature_confirmed_by is not null and nature_confirmed_by == human)
    conditions:
      amount_positive:
        description: The amount given is above zero.
        expression: inputs.amount > USD 0.00
        remedy: self_serviceable
      spent_in_past:
        description: The day of the expense is not in the future, allowing a day, since the claimant's today is a day ahead of UTC's east of it for part of each day.
        expression: inputs.expense_date <= date(now) + 1 day
        remedy: self_serviceable
      category_in_use:
        description: The category given is in use.
        expression: inputs.category.state == ExpenseCategory.IN_USE
        remedy: self_serviceable
      within_policy:
        description: The amount given is no more than its category's policy amount.
        expression: inputs.amount <= inputs.category.policy_amount
        remedy: self_serviceable
      claim_editable:
        description: The line's claim is a draft or has been sent back for changes.
        expression: claim.state == Claim.DRAFT or claim.state == Claim.RETURNED
        remedy: dependent
      claim_under_review:
        description: The line's claim is under review.
        expression: claim.state == Claim.SUBMITTED
        remedy: dependent
      nature_unconfirmed:
        description: No person has yet confirmed the line's nature.
        expression: nature is null
        remedy: unreachable_from_here
    transitions:
      add:
        kind: initial
        to: LISTED
        description: A line is added to its claim.
        only_via: [Claim.add_line]
        required_inputs: [claim, amount, category, expense_date, receipt]
        optional_inputs: [purpose, merchant, original_amount, original_currency]
        guards:
          amount_positive: deny
          spent_in_past: deny
          category_in_use: deny
          within_policy: warn
      amend:
        kind: internal
        from: LISTED
        description: The claimant replaces the line's details, which undoes any suggestion or confirmation of its nature.
        required_inputs: [amount, category, expense_date, receipt]
        optional_inputs: [purpose, merchant, original_amount, original_currency]
        guards:
          claim_editable: deny
          amount_positive: deny
          spent_in_past: deny
          category_in_use: deny
          within_policy: warn
        effect:
          - clear: [suggested_nature, suggestion_rationale, nature, nature_confirmed_by]
      discard:
        kind: external
        from: LISTED
        to: REMOVED
        description: The claimant takes the line off the claim.
        guards:
          claim_editable: deny
      suggest_nature:
        kind: internal
        from: LISTED
        description: The agent suggests whether the line is an expense or a purchase; the suggestion commits nothing.
        # the agent's, so its generated tools offer it (ADR-0189)
        taken_by: [agent]
        required_inputs: [suggested_nature]
        optional_inputs: [suggestion_rationale]
        guards:
          nature_unconfirmed: deny
      confirm_nature:
        kind: internal
        from: LISTED
        description: A person confirms the line's nature, accepting or overriding the agent's suggestion.
        required_inputs: [nature]
        guards:
          claim_under_review: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: nature_confirmed_by, expr: actor.kind }
      close:
        kind: external
        from: LISTED
        to: CLOSED
        description: The line closes with its claim.
        only_via: [Claim.pay, Claim.reject, Claim.withdraw]
      erase:
        kind: erasure
        taken_by: [human]
        description: Erases the line's personal data.
        inputs:
          reason: { type: string }
    metrics:
      amount_claimed_by_category:
        description: The amount claimed in each category, by the month the money was spent, over the lines of every claim submitted and not withdrawn.
        source: objects
        item: l
        filter: l.state != ClaimLine.REMOVED and l.claim.first_submitted_at is not null and l.claim.state != Claim.WITHDRAWN
        dimensions:
          expense_category: l.category
          spent_month: month(l.expense_date)
        time_dimension: l.expense_date
        expression: sum(l.amount)
      line_policy_flags:
        description: How many times a line was entered or amended above its category's policy amount, by rule and month.
        source: attempt_counts
        item: a
        filter: a.flagged
        dimensions:
          rule: a.clause
          flagged_month: month(a.day)
        time_dimension: a.day
        expression: sum(a.count)
"}
